sloka: कांचनस्य च शैलस्य सूर्यस्य च महात्मनः ।आविष्टा तेजसा संध्या पूर्वा रक्ता प्रकाशते ॥४-४०-६३॥
transliteration: kāṁcanasya ca śailasya sūryasya ca mahātmanaḥ ।āviṣṭā tejasā saṁdhyā pūrvā raktā prakāśate ॥4-40-63॥

translations.english: 'Here is the entrance for the earth as well as for all the worlds and since the Sun also rises from this place it is called the eastern direction.
